subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2 scope + evidence needs (Acme)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: TJ Harper <t.harper@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2 scope + evidence needs (Acme)

Hi TJ —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and the proposed next steps so we have alignment on scope and timelines. If anything below looks off, flag and I’ll update.

Pain points you reiterated
- Need for SOC 2 Type II evidence for initial integration and ongoing quarterly reviews
- Audit log retention and ability to export logs for 13 months (regulatory requirement)
- Clear contract language (DPA + audit rights) and evidence for pen test and vulnerability management
- Predictable SLAs for latency/uptime during onboarding window

Goals
- Provide SOC 2 Type II report and summarized controls map by next week (target: 2026-12-07)
- Share pen test summary and remediation tracker for the last calendar year
- Deliver draft DPA with standard redlines for Acme legal to review
- Confirm audit log export process and retention policy details (13 months)

Agreed next steps
1) I’ll share the SOC 2 Type II report and a controls mapping document (attached).
2) Security team will send pen test summary and top remediation items (attached).
3) Legal will circulate our DPA draft; please indicate any must-have clauses for Acme (Khaled noted audit rights + subprocessor list).
4) We’ll schedule a brief follow-up with our infra engineer Dev Patel to walk through log export and retention (propose Wed 12/2 at 10am PT).

Attachments included in this thread: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf, pen_test_summary_redwood_2026.pdf, DPA_Redwood_vAcme_v1.2.docx

If that matches your notes, I’ll spin up a DocuSign envelope for the DPA draft and lock in the follow-up.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

--
Marissa Cole
Redwood Inference

From: TJ Harper <t.harper@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Security Team <security@acme.com>, Khaled Amin <k.amin@procure.acme.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 scope + evidence needs (Acme)

Thanks Marissa — this is great and aligned with our notes. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

1) SOC 2 report: we need the full report (not redacted) for our internal audit team. If there are parts you consider sensitive, please call that out and we can handle accordingly.
2) Pen test evidence: we don’t need raw test logs, but we need the executive summary + VA/PT remediation tracker and dates for fixes.
3) DPA: Khaled is our procurement lead — he will want a clause allowing onsite evidence review or remote audit access, and a signed subprocessor list.
4) Log retention: confirm retention window (13 months) and whether exports can be scheduled as CSV/JSON and pulled by our SREs. Also include any PII redaction options.

Can you confirm timing on the unredacted SOC 2 and whether you can provide a short walkthrough for our audit team next week? Appreciate the quick turnaround.

-TJ
\

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: TJ Harper <t.harper@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 scope + evidence needs (Acme)

TJ — thanks. Quick answers inline and next actions below.

1) SOC 2 unredacted: We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA/controlled access. Attached is our full Type II report; if you need the original encrypted bundle, we can provision S3 ACL-based access for your audit team.
2) Pen test: Attached is the executive summary and remediation tracker (we’ve removed raw exploitation artifacts). If you need additional detail for specific findings we can schedule a short call with our security lead.
3) DPA: Draft attached (DPA_Redwood_vAcme_v1.2.docx). Khaled — we included a clause for remote audit and listed subprocessor notification commitments. If Acme requires onsite evidence review, we’ll surface the process and lead time in the DPA.
4) Log retention/export: Redwood retains structured audit logs for 13 months by default. Exports can be generated as JSON or CSV via our Console and we can set up an S3 delivery or API callback for your SREs. PII redaction is configurable at export time; we can demo options.

Next concrete steps:
- I’ll start a DocuSign envelope for the DPA draft today and share the link (expected by EOD).
- Rishi, can you confirm availability for a 30-minute audit walkthrough on Tue 12/1 or Wed 12/2? We’ll include our security lead and Dev for log export demo.
- TJ/Khaled, please confirm if you need unredacted SOC 2 via SharePoint link or S3 access.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf (full report), pen_test_summary_redwood_2026.pdf, DPA_Redwood_vAcme_v1.2.docx

Thanks — we’ll aim to keep this moving so procurement has everything before your mid-December review.

Best,

Marissa
\

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 scope + evidence needs (Acme)

Quick internal note: I reviewed the attachments and they look good for sharing under our standard controlled-access process. Dev — I’m available Wed 12/2 10am PT for the log export demo; please block 30m. Monica — loop in security lead as needed.

I’ll also prep a short controls map (one-pager) that maps Acme’s asks to our control IDs to speed their audit review. I can have that by EOD 12/1.

-Rishi
